inclusions.text: Private car service from the terminal to your hotel in the city
inclusions.source: The Aswan airport transfer is exactly what it claims to be: a competent, private car service that collects you from the terminal and delivers you to your hotel in the city.

inclusions.text: Travel2Egypt representative waiting in the arrivals hall with a name sign
inclusions.source: Once you have collected your luggage, a Travel2Egypt representative will be waiting in the arrivals hall holding a sign with your name.

inclusions.text: Escort to a private, air-conditioned vehicle
inclusions.source: From that point, the transfer is straightforward: the representative escorts you to a private, air-conditioned vehicle, your bags go in, and the drive to your hotel begins.
